@Shuangqing overview
the 1-Lipschitz maps
the cup-out
the length of the seam
the gluing map The main theme of this session is to find a 1-Lipschitz map from a pair of pants to the complete 3-cusped surface. Based on Thurston's cut-out argument, if we can obtain a cusped surface in this way, then by continuity, we can get a pair of pants of required boundary length. Since this map would be 1-Lipschitz, we complete the general case of Lemma 3.4.Also, we mention the compromising in the construction of orthogonal foliations.First extend the pair of pants to a complete hyperbolic surface, this means gluing 3 funnels to the boundary circles. Choose a geodesic which intersects one boundary circle twice, and both ends go out to infinity to the same end of the surface. If there is a nearby geodesic , then we can cut out the strip between and glue the new boundary components.The resulting surface determines a pair of pants, where two boundary circles remain the same, and one boundary circle gets shorter.
After the cut, the upper boundary circle will not be a geodesic, the cuff 'goes upper', which means the map is not surjective. This gets clearer in the right-angle hexagon picture. The length of seam satisfies If are parallel in the sense that is perpendicular to for all , then the seam remains a geodesic, say of length , we also have Now , so , and in order to get a cusp, we can solve for , i.e. . (according to the sinh law, the other two seams tend to infinity as tends to this value)
The resulting surface consists of four trirectangles, each has one 0 angleIn such a trirectangle, we have which means Sum up to get .By the way, we obtain an identityIn order to get a 1-Lipschitz map, at least we should glue via isometry. There are two possible ways of gluing.
Consider the universal cover. The left picture uses the Fermi coordinate, and the right picture uses horocyclesIn the Fermi coordinates, we parameterize the fibers between with the signed hyperbolic distance to the middle segment, say , where is the coordinate along the middle segment, and is the signed hyperbolic distance to the middle segment. Then the -lines are perpendicular to all the fibers, we glue along these -lines to get an 1-Lipschitz map.For the horocycle method, we contract to the middle line by gluing along the horocycles, note that the horocycles are perpendicular to all the lines between and .
There are more gluing method, say taking curves in the picture, and gluing, this immediately gives a -cupsed sphere.

info_showOrphanNodes.description: 显示未连接到任何其他节点的节点。

info_showAttachments.description: 将附件（如图像和PDF）显示为图中的节点。

info_allowGlobalGraph.description: 允许用户查看所有节点的全局图。

info_allowExpand.description: 允许用户将图形视图弹出至全屏显示。

info_attractionForce.description: 链接节点之间的吸引力有多大？吸引力越大，图形将显得越集中。

info_linkLength.description: 节点之间的链接应有多长？链接越短，节点将聚集得更紧密。

info_repulsionForce.description: 节点之间的排斥力有多大？排斥力越大，分离的节点将分散得越远。

info_centralForce.description: 节点被吸引到中心的程度有多大？吸引力越大，图形看起来越密集和呈圆形。

info_edgePruning.description: 超过此阈值长度的边将不会显示，但仍然参与图形计算。这有助于大型复杂图形显得更加有序。悬停在节点上时，仍会显示这些链接。

info_minNodeRadius.description: 最小节点的大小是多少？节点越小，吸引其他节点的力量越小。

info_maxNodeRadius.description: 最大节点的大小是多少？节点大小取决于它们的链接数量。节点越大，吸引其他节点的力量越大。这有助于围绕最重要的节点形成良好的分组。

info_allowResizing.description: 是否允许用户调整侧边栏的大小

info_allowCollapsing.description: 是否允许用户折叠侧边栏
